definitions.explanation: A stretch of land with particular characteristics or designated for a specific purpose. Often used with modifying words to describe the type of zone.

examples.japanese: この{地帯|ちたい}は{地震|じしん}が{多|おお}い。
{熱帯|ねったい}{地帯|ちたい}には{多様|たよう}な{生物|せいぶつ}が{生息|せいそく}している。
examples.english: Diverse organisms live in tropical zones.

examples.japanese: {工業|こうぎょう}{地帯|ちたい}の{開発|かいはつ}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Development of the industrial zone is progressing.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUND PATTERNS:

CLIMATE ZONES:
- {熱帯|ねったい}{地帯|ちたい} (tropical zone)
- {温帯|おんたい}{地帯|ちたい} (temperate zone)
- {寒帯|かんたい}{地帯|ちたい} (frigid zone)

LAND USE ZONES:
- {工業|こうぎょう}{地帯|ちたい} (industrial zone)
- {商業|しょうぎょう}{地帯|ちたい} (commercial zone)
- {住宅|じゅうたく}{地帯|ちたい} (residential zone)
- {緑|りょく}{地帯|ちたい} (green belt)

OTHER:
- {危険|きけん}{地帯|ちたい} (danger zone)
- {被災|ひさい}{地帯|ちたい} (disaster-affected area)

CONTRAST: {地域|ちいき} is more general (area/region), while {地帯|ちたい} emphasizes a strip or belt with specific characteristics.
